operation.title: Operation
operation.description: "write" (default): export an Apify dataset or JSON rows to the sheet. "read": import a sheet tab or range into this run's dataset as JSON rows. With no datasetId or rawData, the run reads the sheet instead.

spreadsheet.title: Spreadsheet URL or ID
spreadsheet.description: Required. Full Google Sheets URL (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ID/edit). Share the sheet first (Editor to write, Viewer to read) with sheets-tool@apify-tools-512508.iam.gserviceaccount.com and untick "Notify people". AI agents: on a permission error, ask the user to share it. Not needed with your own service account key. The prefill is Google's public sample sheet, so a first run reads it into a dataset.

sheetName.title: Sheet tab name
sheetName.description: Tab to read or write. Leave empty for the tab in the URL (gid) or the first tab. When writing, a missing tab is created for you.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID (write)
datasetId.description: String: the Apify dataset ID to export, e.g. "aBcD1234efGH5678" from a run's Storage tab. In an integration (run this after another actor finishes) use {{resource.defaultDatasetId}}. Leave empty when you use rawData.

writeMode.title: Write mode
writeMode.description: "append" (default): add rows below the existing data; new columns are added to the header. "replace": overwrite the tab with the new data; old rows are cleared only after the new data is written.

deduplicateBy.title: Deduplicate by columns
deduplicateBy.description: Array of column names, e.g. ["url"] or ["id"]. Skips rows whose values in these columns already exist (in the sheet when appending, and within the data). Skipped rows are free. Works for read too.

columns.title: Columns (optional)
columns.description: Array of column names to keep, in this order, e.g. ["name","price","address.city"]. Nested fields use dots. Leave empty for all fields.

arrayHandling.title: Arrays
arrayHandling.description: How to put arrays into cells: join simple lists with commas, store as JSON, or expand into numbered columns (tags/0, tags/1…).

valueInputOption.title: Cell values
valueInputOption.description: "RAW" (default) stores text exactly as-is (safe: values starting with = are not run as formulas). "USER_ENTERED" lets Google parse numbers, dates and formulas as if typed.

rawData.title: Raw data (write, instead of a dataset)
rawData.description: Optional array of objects to write instead of a dataset, e.g. [{"name":"A","price":1},{"name":"B","price":2}].

range.title: Range (read)
range.description: Optional A1 range within the tab, e.g. "A1:F500" or "B:D". Leave empty for the whole tab.

valueRender.title: Read values as
valueRender.description: Read only. "FORMATTED_VALUE" (default): what you see in the sheet, e.g. "$1.50". "UNFORMATTED_VALUE": raw numbers and booleans.

skipEmptyRows.title: Skip empty rows
skipEmptyRows.description: Read only: ignore fully empty rows (default true).

headerRow.title: First row is a header
headerRow.description: Read: use row 1 as field names. Write: write/merge column names into row 1.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows (0 = no limit).

serviceAccountKey.title: Your own service account key (optional)
serviceAccountKey.description: Advanced: paste the full JSON key of your own Google Cloud service account (with Sheets and Drive APIs enabled). Then share your sheet with that account's email instead of ours. Stored encrypted as a secret input.
